definition: Worlds agreeing on the truth of every base fact (the #736 SameEvidence) agree on the favouring by each base member. NecessaryBase: every base fact is true at a and its accessible worlds. ExhaustiveAt and ExclusiveAt: at least one, and at most one, field member is true at the world.
note: Candidate condition under test, not a law. Its rival is favouring that varies with the outcome, as settled does. A base can be enlarged by any further varying fact, and then the worlds no longer agree on it. See docs/notes/explanatory-symmetry-742.md.
